findings.current: Having had his thoughts read earlier was nothing.
findings.defect: The pronoun makes Jin the one whose thoughts were read. The Grand Mage is reflecting on Jin seeing through her intentions.
findings.rationale: Her earlier mistake exposed her true intentions to Jin; this sentence dismisses that mistake as less important than her failure to understand the title.
findings.replacement: Having had her thoughts read earlier was nothing.
findings.source: 앞서 마음을 읽힌 것 따위는 아무것도 아니었다.

findings.current: having realized something had happened to their hostage, Jin Taekyung
findings.defect: “Their hostage” assigns Jin’s captivity to the Bow Saint and Jeok Cheongang rather than the Grand Mage.
findings.rationale: The two are rushing toward Jin because they see that something has happened to him while he is held hostage.
findings.replacement: having realized something had happened to Jin Taekyung, who was being held hostage
findings.source: 인질로 잡혀 있던 진태경의 신변에 문제가 생겼음을 깨닫고 쏘아지던 궁성과 적천강

findings.rationale: The binding panel format excludes brackets; 어떻게 했나 싶은 marks the achievement as improbable, while 배 째 is a defiant challenge rather than a neutral request.

findings.current: And I was a superhuman with the physical ability and senses to surpass the limits of a Blink spell, despite its short range.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the concrete pursuit mechanism—catching up to a short-range teleport—with the abstract claim that Jin surpasses the spell’s limits.
findings.rationale: Jin knows where she reappeared and can cover the distance; he does not alter or overcome a limit of the spell itself.
findings.replacement: And I was a superhuman whose extraordinary strength and senses could catch up with Blink despite its limited range.
findings.source: 단거리라는 한계를 지닌 블링크를 따라잡을 수 있는, 한계 이상의 신체 능력과 감각을 지닌 초인이었으니까.

findings.current: Now it was time to collect the price of the wager I’d made.
findings.defect: The draft omits that Jin intends to collect from his opponent, the immediate target of his counterattack.
findings.rationale: 상대에게서 identifies the person who must pay, carrying the gambling metaphor into the attack.
findings.replacement: Now it was time to collect my winnings from the other side of the bet.
findings.source: 그리고 이제는, 내가 걸었던 판돈의 대가를 상대에게서 받아야 할 때였다.

summary: The draft changes who had their thoughts read, misidentifies whose hostage Jin is, and loses a few consequential details in the System notice and final pursuit.
